title: Waiver of rights.
bodyText: The failure of an aggrieved person to comply with sections 454F-41 and 454F-42 shall constitute a waiver of the rights contained in those sections.
bodyHtml: [§454F-46]  Waiver of rights.  The failure of an aggrieved person to comply with sections 454F-41 and 454F-42 shall constitute a waiver of the rights contained in those sections. [L 2010, c 84, pt of §3]
